metadata.title: System Security Plan — Example Location-Safety Service (illustrative)
metadata.remarks: Illustrative SSP for the example archetype in config.example.yaml (a consumer location-safety service). Generated by tools/generate_ssp.py from the Living Control Set catalog and the SOC 2 (TSC 2017) Profile selection. Makes no claim about any real organization's posture. UUIDs are RFC-4122 v4-format, derived deterministically from the content fingerprint: any content change regenerates the root uuid and every element uuid and bumps last-modified.

system-characteristics.description: Illustrative archetype: a privately held consumer location-safety service that processes precise location and minors' data and runs an agentic AI layer on a real-time location graph. Defined in config.example.yaml; not a real system.

information-types.title: Real-time location graph (members incl. minors)
information-types.description: Precise geolocation and account data for members, including children, plus derived safety events. Illustrative data description for the example archetype.

status.remarks: Illustrative example system; no operational status is claimed.

authorization-boundary.description: The example service's production environment: the location graph data stores, the agentic AI layer, and the supporting identity, logging, and consent systems named in config.example.yaml. Illustrative boundary for the archetype.

components.title: Example Location-Safety Service
components.description: The example location-safety service as a whole; the single component every control statement is implemented by in this illustrative SSP.

control-implementation.description: One implemented-requirement per control selected by SOC 2 (TSC 2017) Profile from the Living Control Set. Statement narratives are carried verbatim from 02-controls/control-library.yaml; parameters are set from the catalog's defined values (set-parameter, never prose).

by-components.description: Policies for AI and autonomous-technology risk are defined, owned, and enforced. Autonomous agents read precise location or minor data only under purpose-bound authorization, at minimum scope, with full decision logging, and with human accountability for high-impact actions. No agent holds standing access to sensitive production data. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

values: material change to agent scope, model, or purpose

by-components.description: Minor personal data processes only after verifiable parent or guardian opt-in consent is recorded. Consent state is authoritative: absent or withdrawn consent blocks processing and disclosure, and a separate verifiable consent is required before any disclosure of a child's data to a third party. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

values: under 13 (COPPA); broader where local law sets a higher age
methods recognized under 16 CFR 312.5(b) for the processing in question

by-components.description: Privileges for people and service accounts are reviewed on a fixed cadence against role and employment, and unjustified access is removed. Leaver deprovisioning fires from the human-resources system of record, not a manual ticket. Service and other non-human accounts are held to the same bar as human accounts. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

values: same business day as the HR event

by-components.description: Technical configuration change reaches production only through a peer-reviewed pull request linked to a tracked work item, with required checks passing. Direct pushes to protected branches are blocked, the reviewer is independent of the author, and emergency changes follow a documented after-the-fact review. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

values: build, automated tests, and security checks must pass

by-components.description: Enterprise monitoring computes control health continuously. Security events ship to a central append-only store with retention and integrity protection. Logs establish what, when, where, source, outcome, and identity, and defined event types alert a monitored queue with an acknowledgement SLA. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

values: 365 days; longer where an obligation in scope requires it

by-components.description: Third parties with system or personal-data access are tiered by what they can touch, assessed before onboarding, and bound by security, breach-notice, and processing terms. High-risk parties reassess on cadence, and vendor trust evidence is reused rather than re-questionnaired. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

values: current SOC 2 Type II or ISO 27001, scope recorded

by-components.description: Incidents are detected, triaged, contained, and recorded against a governed plan, including AI scope breaches. Legal/Privacy owns notification within statutory timelines, and every incident receives a post-incident review. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

values: 72 hours where GDPR applies; the applicable statutory window otherwise
at least annual, including an AI-scope scenario

by-components.description: Sensitive and regulated data is protected with cryptographic controls that meet a defined standard, in transit and at rest. Keys are generated, stored, rotated, and revoked under a documented key-management process, separated from the data they protect. Weak or deprecated algorithms and protocols are not used, and exceptions are tracked and time-bound. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

Technical vulnerabilities across code, dependencies, images, and infrastructure are discovered continuously, triaged by severity and exposure, and remediated within defined service levels. Internet-facing and sensitive-data systems carry the tightest timelines. Unremediated vulnerabilities past SLA are tracked as exceptions with a named owner and a closure plan. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

Data is classified by sensitivity, and precise location and minor data are designated the highest-sensitivity class. Handling, retention, and disposal rules attach to the classification and are enforced. Data is minimized to what the declared purpose requires and deleted or restricted when the lawful basis ends. Cleartext flows of the highest-sensitivity classes are inventoried so every other control knows its scope. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

Personnel complete security and privacy awareness training on hire and on a recurring cadence, and role-based training is delivered to functions with elevated access or specific obligations. Training covers the risks specific to this service: precise-location and minor-data handling, social-engineering resistance, and the governance of the agentic AI layer. Completion is tracked, and non-completion for in-scope roles is an exception with a named owner. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

A documented security and privacy program defines scope, ownership, and objectives, is approved by leadership, and is reviewed at least annually. Authority and accountability for the program are assigned to a named function. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

Policies, standards, and procedures form a maintained hierarchy with named owners, a review cadence, and version control. Each document is reviewed and re-approved on cadence or on material change. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

Security responsibilities are assigned by role and documented in a RACI. Conflicting duties are separated; where separation is impractical, a compensating control is recorded. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

Control health and program performance are measured and reported to leadership on a fixed cadence, with material risks escalated. Metrics are computed from systems of record, not assembled by hand. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

Risk is assessed using a documented, repeatable method that estimates likelihood and impact in defined terms. Assessments run on cadence and on significant change. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

Identified risks are recorded in a register with an owner, treatment decision, and target date. Accepted risk is approved at an authority level matched to its severity. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

A maintained inventory records hardware, software, services, and data stores with an owner for each. The inventory is reconciled from authoritative discovery, not a manual list. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

Assets and data are classified by sensitivity against a defined scheme, and handling requirements follow from the classification. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

Media and equipment holding confidential data are sanitized or destroyed before disposal or reuse, with the action recorded. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

Access is granted, changed, and revoked from authoritative HR events. Leaver access is removed on the same day the leaver event fires; the feed is the trigger, not a ticket. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

Access follows least privilege. Privileged access is brokered, time-bound where feasible, and separately logged. Standing administrative access is minimized. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

Users authenticate with unique identities and phishing-resistant multi-factor where supported. MFA is enforced for remote and administrative access. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

Service accounts, API keys, and workload identities are registered with an owner, scoped to least privilege, and rotated or expired. No standing secret without an owner. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

Systems are built from approved, hardened baselines, and deviations are detected and reconciled. Baselines follow a recognized hardening standard. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

Cryptographic keys are generated, stored, rotated, and retired under a defined lifecycle, with access to key material restricted and logged. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

Data is retained only as long as required by a defined schedule and is disposed of when the schedule expires, with disposal recorded. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

Personal data is processed for a stated purpose under a documented lawful basis, and a plain-language notice describes what is collected, why, and the individual's rights. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

Requests to access, correct, delete, or port personal data are honored within statutory timelines, with identity verified before action. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

Logs are protected against alteration with write-once or equivalent integrity controls and retained for a defined period. Clocks are synchronized to an authoritative source. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

Networks are segmented by trust and sensitivity, and traffic crossing boundaries is filtered by default-deny rules that are reviewed on cadence. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

Remote access to internal resources is authenticated, encrypted, and least-privilege, and administrative access originates from controlled paths. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

Security requirements and checks are built into design, build, test, and deploy stages, and a release cannot pass without its required gates emitting evidence. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

Third-party and open-source components are inventoried, scanned for known vulnerabilities, and verified for integrity before use. Build provenance is recorded. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

Secrets are stored in a managed vault, never in source or configuration, and are scanned for in code. Exposed secrets are rotated on detection. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

Independent testing exercises the environment on cadence and after significant change, and findings feed the remediation queue and the risk register. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

Endpoints run managed protection that detects and responds to malicious activity, with coverage and health monitored centrally. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

Managed devices enforce configuration, disk encryption, and screen lock, and access from unmanaged devices to confidential data is restricted. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

When an incident meets a statutory or contractual threshold, affected parties and regulators are notified within required windows, with the decision and its basis recorded. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

Recovery objectives are set from a business impact analysis, and continuity and recovery plans are documented, resourced, and tested on cadence. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

Critical data and systems are backed up on a defined schedule with backups protected and restoration verified by test, not assumption. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

Where personal or sensitive data flows to subprocessors, processing terms, breach-notice windows, and transfer mechanisms are in place and recorded. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

Personnel are screened proportionate to role before access, and acknowledge security and confidentiality obligations. A disciplinary path exists for violations. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

Physical access to facilities and data-bearing equipment is restricted, logged, and reviewed. Where infrastructure is cloud-hosted, provider attestations are inherited and tracked. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)

Changes to models, prompts, and tool grants follow change control with pre-deployment evaluation, drift checks, rollback, and an approval gate. (Illustrative: carried verbatim from the Living Control Set statement for the example archetype; not a claim about a real organization.)
